ballotMeasures.summary:
Citizenship Requirement to Vote in West Virginia Elections Amendment. This amendment provides that in all elections held in West Virginia only citizens of the United States who are citizens of this state are qualified to vote.

In short: Would amend Article IV, Section 1 of the state constitution to state that only citizens of the United States who are citizens of West Virginia may vote in elections held in the state.

Official ballot language. Source: https://moorefieldexaminer.com/2026/08/04/public-notice-proposed-amendment-to-the-wv-constitution-to-be-on-the-november-3-2026-general-election-ballot/
